review_description: Installation was delayed 3 times - originally because of weather then because of backlog. When installers came they advised that the price quoted to us was incorrect and they had to refer it back to Coast 2 Country for requote. We were then quoted an extra $1000 - we told them to cancel it.That afternoon I got a visit from the salesman who originally quoted us. He said that it was his fault and that they would stand by the original quote and have it installed within 48 hours if we agreed to let it go ahead. We agreed. That was mid June. We were finally connected around mid July.Overall they did the right thing standing by their quote (but each time I called them to see what was happening they reminded me that they were taking a very big hit on this job - like they were doing me a favour - they could have just let us cancel the job like we originally intended!).The installers were great - they are sub-contractors.I would not recommend Coast 2 Country to anyone.

A local firm that performed as salesman promised. A neat & tidy installation with good attention to the roof sarking. We had a tight time frame & they met it.  Very pleasant installers who are contractors to C2C. Would recommend these people.This feedback form is what I would liked to have seen before making my decision, it would have been easier & a lot more comforting.Thanks for your assistance with all the advice in your emails.
